finding.answer: The tents category had the highest return rate in Q3 2026, with a return rate of 19.4% of orders. This reflects that roughly one in five tent orders were returned, which may warrant a review of product quality or customer expectations.
data_issues: Duplicate order_id values (70) were found; orders were aggregated by order_id using the most frequent category and treating any returned line item as a returned order.
No inconsistent returned flags were detected across duplicate order_ids.
No orders were linked to multiple categories.
